title: Speech Practice Coach — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Helps improve pacing, delivery, and confidence before presenting. The Speech Practice Coach helps improve pacing, delivery, and confidence. The student rehearses with the script while the coach times each section, flags rushed passages and long pauses, and checks the total against the time slot. Repeated run-throughs build the timing into memory so the real presentation feels practiced.
capabilities: Time each section of the rehearsal
Flag rushed passages and long pauses
Check total time against the slot
Track improvement across run-throughs
Build timing confidence before the real talk
